province_participation.population: Internet users aged 5+ who accessed the internet during the three months before enumeration; percentage reporting goods/services purchasing as an internet-use purpose.
province_participation.urban_rural_classification: BPS urban/rural classification; not administrative kota/kabupaten.

city_participation.population: Total population, as defined by NEXT's original analysis; not BPS's internet-user denominator or an adult Meta audience.
city_participation.selection: Seven selected high-participation city examples; incomplete and not representative of all kabupaten/kota.

limitations: Apply this baseline only to an explicitly selected Indonesian market or segment; conversation language, account currency and billing country do not select it.
The 2026 publication of Susenas 2025 data is a dated structural baseline, not measured 2026 campaign performance.
Keep BPS internet-user participation, NEXT total-population buyer shares and BI transaction aggregates separate; do not pool their denominators or rankings.
BPS and NEXT share Susenas lineage and are not automatically independent confirmation; NEXT microdata estimates were not independently reproduced.
Provincial BPS coverage is 38/38 for one participation indicator, not complete buyer-behavior coverage. Detailed sample sizes and uncertainty are not supplied here.
Unlisted cities have unknown direct coverage, not zero participation or lower attractiveness. A province may supply an explicitly inherited prior, never a fabricated city measurement.
Participation rates do not establish absolute buyer-pool size, adult Meta reach, individual psychology, purchasing power, category preference or campaign CPA/CPR.

Comparable regional series for payment behavior, shopping frequency, channels, spending distributions and fulfillment/RTS are incomplete in this baseline; missing coverage does not prove that public data does not exist.

BI totals are rounded regional aggregates. Reporting panel, buyer-versus-merchant geographic assignment and refund treatment are unknown; transaction counts are not unique buyers or purchases per person.
BI value divided by count is a mean per reported transaction, not median basket size, brand AOV or willingness to pay. Category mix, seasonality, prices and reporting coverage can affect comparisons.
BPS province codes and administrative names are not Meta targeting keys. City source codes, current account eligibility and live API coverage have not been established.

No source in this dataset establishes an optimal age/gender setting, automatic geographic budget ranking or profitable campaign outcome. A 21-65+ setup remains a conditional candidate, not a verified universal Indonesian age floor or performance optimum.
